senses.gloss: (cmp. צְבַת a. צוּת) to join, attach. [B. Mets. 29ᵇ צוית Ms. F., מצוית Ms. R. 2, v. צְוַץ].

units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 80a:3">B. Bath. 80ᵃ</cite> <he>אמה דמִיצְטַוְּתָא אברתא וכ׳</he> (Ar. <he>דמיצטב׳</he>) the mother bird will be attached to the daughter bird and to the mate that we leave with her, <he>איהי נמי תִיצְטַוַּות וכ׳</he> (not <he>תיצטוה</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 300-400) she (the daughter), too, will remain attached to her mother &c.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 80a:3">Ib.</cite> <he>אמה אברתה מיצטוותא וכ׳</he> the mother remains attached to the daughter, but not so the daughter &c.
